//: The organization's manifest overlay (spec 035 §3.3). This file is YOURS.
An upgrade replaces every chassis file and never touches this one.
It may declare `capabilities`, `services` and `resources`, and it may add
capabilities to a chassis service. It may not redefine anything the chassis
declared: scripts/gen-manifest.mjs refuses the collision rather than
resolving it, because a silently overridden grant is a widened ceiling that
reads, in the composed file, exactly like a chassis decision.
After editing, run `npm run gen:manifest` and commit app-manifest.json.
Example: a grants-management extension with its own kind and controller.
